sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Hide playback controls at stream open
Keeps playback controls hidden when a stream opens or the player switches between embedded and fullscreen. The controls remain available.
Helps the Android TV remote reveal native playback controls and focus the seekbar when available. Live streams may not be seekable.
Removes ads and promo popups, and keeps channels working after patching.
